title: Architectural Engineering
subject: Engineering
summary: Learn how buildings are designed to be safe, efficient and sustainable, from structure to energy systems.
description: Architectural engineering sits between architecture and engineering. You study structures, building services and sustainable design.
Graduates work on everything from homes to large commercial projects.
entryRequirements: A-levels or equivalent Level 3, usually including Maths
GCSE English and Maths at grade 4/C or above
